Kenito does treat Oliver bad do as he would rape him at every small mistake as Olivers talent blinded him and makes him forget Oliver is a human to. Oliver only bad thing was that he is very short and slim which makes it easy to push him if someone could but if that happends Kenito get protective and would take care of Oliver instant and carry him of the field and make sure he is alright and Kenito did not see that as a mistake and he would feel so bad of that Oliver fell like that and if Oliver felt a single slight pain Kenito would put him in his lap and keep him there for the rest of the match and complain about the other players. He made Oliver the captain of the team and Oliver was number 7.
